Record Class MongoEntityIndexes.ResolvedIndex

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.data.mongodb.common.MongoEntityIndexes.ResolvedIndex
Record Components:
name - The index name
fields - The index fields
unique - Whether unique
sparse - Whether sparse
hidden - Whether hidden
expireAfterSeconds - TTL in seconds if any
partialFilterExpression - The partial filter expression JSON
collation - The collation JSON
bits - The geospatial bits option for 2d indexes
min - The geospatial min option for 2d indexes
max - The geospatial max option for 2d indexes
defaultLanguage - The text index default language
languageOverride - The text index language override field
textIndexVersion - The text index version
sphereVersion - The 2dsphere index version
wildcardProjection - The wildcard projection JSON
storageEngine - The storage engine options JSON
comment - The index creation comment
commitQuorum - The createIndexes commit quorum
Enclosing class:
MongoEntityIndexes

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
